change: AI-ranked search results in place of the keyword ranking
decision: Launch the AI ranking to all customers, or not
population: triggered customers: those who searched at least once during the test

primary.metric: orders per triggered customer over the 28 days
primary.analysis: difference in means with regression adjustment on the same metric over the 28 pre-period days; 95% interval

guardrails.metric: search latency p95 (ms), treatment minus control
complaints per 1,000 orders, upper 95% bound of the difference
revenue per triggered customer, lower 95% bound of the relative difference

decision_rule: Launch if the primary interval is above zero and every guardrail holds. Iterate if the primary interval is above zero and a non-harm guardrail fails. Stop if the primary interval includes zero or falls below it, or if the harm guardrail fails.
